translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Puhai ia too, iya nalipim DEBATA Abram anna napa'tula'i naua: “Daa ummahea' Abram, aka Kao la umpa'tippasangko anna la kubeengko mana' kasalle.”

Sapo' natimba' Abram naua: “O Puang Allataala DEBATAngku, aka gunana la umbeennä' mana' ke tä'i deem änä'ku? Aka tä'pä' umbeem änä', dadi inde mai kulle puha umbeennä', indo hi tia sabua'ku Eliezer to Damsyik la umpomana'i.”
Natimba' DEBATA naua: “Taia sabua'mu la umpomana' kullemu, sapo' änä' ikalemu.”
Iya umpasolam messubum Abram anna nauaanni: “Pentongako längäm langi' anna uhhekengko bintä, ke umbelai. Aka padai too budanna bintä, la padam too duka' budanna pessubummu.”
Iya ungkatappa'im DEBATA Abram nasuhum nasangai DEBATA to malolo.
Mane ma'kada polei DEBATA naua: “Kaom too untässu'iko illaam mai Ur-Kasdim botto litä'mu anna kutetteko sule eta inde pa'bottoam aka la umpomana'.”
Natimba' Abram naua: “O Puang Allataala DEBATAngku, la kuaka susi anna mala kuissam kuua inde litä' la kupomana'?”
Natimba' DEBATA naua: “Alaannä' mesa sapim bihä, mesa beke bihä, anna mesa beke laki sapo' la sangngim tallu taummi dadinna. Anna mesapi duka' bukku' sola mesa dangam-dangam sapo' mangnguhannapi.”
Iya naalaammi Abram DEBATA ingganna indo olo'-olo'. Iya sangngim naseseannim, anna napaokko'i napadua bahhi' napasisabaliam. Anggam indo bukku' sola dangam-dangam tä' ia naseseanni.
Tappa sule siaham buda dassi to peande bale uhhampoi indo bale sapo' nahambai Abram.
Tappana la lendu'i allo, tikahu'du'um Abram sampe limpe' mamma'. Pissananna ham tä' deem pada sakähhä bulunna.
Iya ma'kadam DEBATA lako Abram naua: “Indem ia pahallu la umpengngissanni: pessubummu la mendadi to sule dio botto senga', la diposabua' anna la ullambi' pandahhaam appa' hatu' taunna masäena.
Anggam ia ke messubummi la buda kullena pa'botto nababa. Anna indo to la umposabua'i, la nalambi' duka' pesämbä'ku.
Sapo' iko-iko la mahendengko anna la ussi'dim kamasannangam sule lako matemu.

Anna la appa'pi too lapi'na pessubummu dio botto ia too, mane ma'pasulei sule eta inde. Aka etapi mane nalambi'i to Amori pesämbä'ku, aka la lempam polem kakadakeam napogau' illaam inde botto la naongei pessubummu.”
Tappana bengi anna malillim pättäm, iya diitam ongeam api pehambu anna ballo ma'lao-lao illaam alla'na indo bale.
Allo eta siam duka' anna umpadadii pa'dandiam DEBATA lako Abram naua: “Ingganna inde litä' la kubeem pessubummu mengkalao dio salunna Mesir sule lako salu Efrat.
Nakala'pi litä'na to Keni, to Kenas, to Kadmon, to Het, to Feris, to Refaim, to Amori, to Kanaan, to Girgasi, anna to Yebus.”
